intro: I research how people learn with AI, and build the tools to support it.
about: I'm a learning designer pursuing an M.Ed. in Learning Design, Innovation & Technology at Harvard GSE, after earning a First-Class BA in Education Studies at UCL.
I've studied how learners respond to different forms of generative-AI scaffolding, redesigned training programs around flight simulators, and prototyped interactive learning experiences in Figma.

Having grown up in China, studied in the UK, and now living in the US, I bring a cross-cultural lens to how people learn. Outside class, I co-founded Voices & Co- and make vlogs, because good learning, like good stories, starts with people.
